case_number: Civil Appeal No. ___ of 2023 [Arising out of Special Leave Petition (C) No. 3329 of 2021]
summary: The appeal challenged the Allahabad High Court's review order dated 05.02.2021 that reversed its earlier dismissal of a special appeal. The issue was whether the review was maintainable. The Supreme Court held that no error apparent on the face of the record existed, and the High Court exceeded its jurisdiction by rehearing the appeal under the guise of review. The Court upheld the principle that review is not a re-hearing but limited to correcting patent errors. The impugned review order was set aside, and the original dismissal of the special appeal was reinstated.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 9 read with Section 10, Uttar Pradesh High Schools and Intermediate Colleges (Payment of Salaries of Teachers and other Employees) Act, 1971
State of U.P. through Secretary, Secondary Educations & Ors. vs. C/M, Sri Sukhpal Intermediate College, Tirhut, Sultanpur & Ors. (Special Appeal Defective No.673 of 2014, decided on 12.05.2015)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned review order dated 05.02.2021 set aside; no order as to costs.
